page_title: BOL 1-1 EMP | Bologna v Empoli 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Empoli have a corner.
90+8' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Empoli win a corner.
90+7' That's unlucky! Remo Freuler (Bologna) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
90+5' The game has begun to heat up. Liam Henderson (Empoli) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+4' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+4' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90+4' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+3' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

90+1' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who pulls off a comfortable save!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' One of the Empoli players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
87' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) commits a foul and Livio Marinelli immediately signals a free kick.
84' Bologna take a short corner kick.
84' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
82' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Jhon Lucumi will be replaced by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
82' Riccardo Orsolini goes off the pitch and Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) comes on.
82' Juan Miranda (Bologna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Livio Marinelli no option but to blow his whistle.
80' A player from Bologna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
78' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
75' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
75' Now Empoli have a corner.
74' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
72' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) comes onto the pitch because Giuseppe Pezzella simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
71' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
70' Juan Miranda (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Livio Marinelli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Nicolas Haas (Empoli) coming on for Jacopo Fazzini.
67' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) replaces Ola Solbakken.
66' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' It will be a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Giovanni Fabbian walks off.
63' A cross is whipped in towards Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
61' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
61' Here comes a substitution. Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is brought on as a substitute for Alberto Grassi.
59' A player from Bologna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
57' Stefan Posch (Bologna) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Here is a change. Jesper Karlsson is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michel Aebischer (Bologna) comes onto the pitch for Nikola Moro.
53' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
51' Stefan Posch (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
48' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
48' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Livio Marinelli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Livio Marinelli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Santiago Castro (Bologna).
45+3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+3' Nikola Moro (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Santiago Castro (Bologna) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.

41' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms over the bar.
39' Juan Miranda (Bologna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
39' Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a great save to deny Ola Solbakken (Empoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
38' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
37' Handball! A player from Bologna handled the ball.
36' Santiago Castro (Bologna) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
35' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
34' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
32' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
32' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' Bologna hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
22' PENALTY APPEAL after Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
21' Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Stefan Posch (Bologna). Bologna earn a corner.
16' Santiago Castro (Bologna) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
16' Bologna get a corner.

16' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Stefan Posch (Bologna), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
15' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' A pass from Santiago Castro (Bologna) is intercepted by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach and the move breaks down.
10' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' 1 - 1 GOAL! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) reacts first to the lofted pass and calmly guides the ball into the net with his body.
2' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 1:1.
2' Juan Miranda (Bologna) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Juan Miranda (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Livio Marinelli.
